description: This file implements the Snake game view in an Android application, handling game logic, rendering, input processing, and state management for the Snake game.

classes.name: SnakeView
classes.description: Custom View class implementing the Snake game logic, rendering, and user interaction.

classes.name: RefreshHandler
classes.description: Inner class extending Handler to manage periodic game updates.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.description: Helper class representing a coordinate point on the game grid.

methods.name: initSnakeView
methods.description: Initializes the SnakeView, loads tile resources.

methods.name: initNewGame
methods.description: Resets game state to start a new game.

methods.name: coordArrayListToArray
methods.description: Converts a list of Coordinates into a flattened integer array.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes current game state into a Bundle.

methods.name: coordArrayToArrayList
methods.description: Deserializes a flattened integer array into a list of Coordinates.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from a Bundle.

methods.name: moveSnake
methods.description: Changes the snake's direction or starts a new game based on user input.

methods.name: setDependentViews
methods.description: Sets UI views for status messages and control arrows.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the game mode, updating UI and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: addRandomApple
methods.description: Places a new apple on the grid in a location not occupied by the snake.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Main game loop: updates game state when in RUNNING mode.

methods.name: updateWalls
methods.description: Draws boundary walls around the game area.

methods.name: updateApples
methods.description: Draws all apples on the game grid.

methods.name: updateSnake
methods.description: Moves the snake, detects collisions, handles apple consumption, updates display.
